prompt: Name one of the ten largest US states by area.

answers.name: Alaska
answers.fact: Larger than Texas, California and Montana put together.

answers.name: Texas
answers.fact: The largest of the contiguous states, and its own republic from 1836 to 1845.

answers.name: California
answers.fact: Third largest, and bigger than Germany.

answers.name: Montana
answers.fact: Fourth largest, with about seven people per square mile.

answers.name: Arizona
answers.fact: Sixth largest. The Grand Canyon alone covers nearly 2,000 square miles.

answers.name: Nevada
answers.fact: Seventh largest, and the federal government owns roughly 80% of it.

answers.name: New Mexico
answers.fact: Fifth largest, and the site of the first nuclear test in 1945.

answers.name: Colorado
answers.fact: Eighth largest, and the only state whose borders are all straight lines.

answers.name: Oregon
answers.fact: Ninth largest, and home to the deepest lake in the country.

answers.name: Wyoming
answers.fact: Tenth largest by area and last by population - under 600,000 people.

extras.name: Michigan
extras.fact: Eleventh by area, just outside the ten - but the largest state entirely east of the Mississippi.

extras.name: Minnesota
extras.fact: Twelfth by area - close, but not in the ten.

extras.name: Florida
extras.fact: Third by population, but only 22nd by area.
